payload.description_html:
Some representative species of Osteichthyes. From left to right, top to bottom:
  • Polypterus delhezi / Cladistia
  • Latimeria chalumnae / Actinistia
  • Acipenser oxyrinchus / Chondrostei
  • Neoceratodus forsteri / Dipnoi
  • Lepisosteus oculatus / Holostei
  • Mercurana myristicapalustris / Batrachomorpha
  • Osteoglossum bicirrhosum / Eloposteoglossocephala
  • Sciurus vulgaris / Synapsida
  • Pangasianodon hypophthalmus / Otocephala
  • Furcifer pardalis / Lepidosauromorpha
  • Andinoacara rivulatus / Euteleostei
  • Thalasseus maximus / Archelosauria
